name: GUNS VS FNAF
desc:
UPDATE!!!: Combat mode has been replaced with the "CHAOS MODE"! 🌀
Kill animatronics in this new mode and unlock new and exciting skins for your guns! 
30 skins are now available for your guns! 🔫🎨
Also, the guns system has been improved!!!

🧟 Survive the Chaos and defeat the animatronics! 🔪

Step into a world full of fnaf animatronics! Use your gear to defeat enemies, earn money, unlock powerful weapons, and explore exciting new areas. Every zone is tougher than the last.

💥 Fun battles
🔫 Tons of weapons to collect
🌍 New zones to explore
👥 Play solo or with friends

Join the fight and start your adventure now!
